Star Wars CCG tournaments of 2001 that this wiki has sourced, newest first. The year's World Championship is [[2001 Decipher World Championship]] (champion [[Bastian Winkelhaus]], runner-up [[Martin Akesson]]); every year's Worlds is on [[World Championships]]. Other years: [[List of SWCCG tournaments]].

Most rows come from the published constructed 60s in Decipher Deck Designs and other period sources that name a tournament; each event page cites its source. '''Format''' is the constructed pool named for that event.
